value: International Energy Agency (2019). World Energy Outlook 2019. IEA, Paris, November 2019. 810 pp.

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Scenario outlook (Stated Policies, Current Policies, Sustainable Development) of energy demand, supply, investment and emissions to 2040, by region and fuel. No industrial technology table: industry appears only as aggregate demand and policy lists (Table B.9). The annexes hold scenario projection tables (Annex A) and scenario design (Annex B). What it does have: Annex B Table B.6 (p.758, PDF p.760): capital cost, capacity factor, fuel and O&M, LCOE and VALCOE for utility nuclear, coal, gas CCGT, solar PV and wind (onshore, offshore) in the US, EU, China and India, 2018 and 2040 (price year not printed in the table; WEO-2019 uses $2018). Grid-scale power, not industrial heat; already covered by sourced archetypes (combined-cycle, wind-turbine, photovoltaic). Also fossil fuel prices (Table B.4), CO2 prices (Table B.5), LNG liquefaction capital cost chart (Fig. 4.13).
